purpose: One public-seed development smoke; not a holdout or competitive evaluation.
seed_selection: Four predeclared public development roles from source, checked against recognized history; only S01 is used.
panel: One specified development game and one 719-transition same-engine primary replay; no extra replay.
interpretation: Development smoke only; no economic evaluation or automatic promotion.
stopping: The registered deadline terminates the owned outer Job and its descendants; a started failure, unknown cleanup or interruption stops the whole attempt; no retries or partial scoring.
limitations: History may be missing or unrecognized; the local commitment is neither third-party timestamp nor proof of operator blinding.
